title: StepHttp
description: A capability step that makes one HTTP request. Its body is JSON, a stored artifact's bytes, or a multipart form, and its response is stored under the response's own content type.

HttpBodyJson.title: HttpBodyJson
HttpBodyJson.description: A JSON body. String values are templated, as in an httpjson step's body.

HttpBodyArtifact.title: HttpBodyArtifact
HttpBodyArtifact.description: A stored artifact's bytes as the whole body, sent with the artifact's own content type.

HttpBodyMultipart.title: HttpBodyMultipart
HttpBodyMultipart.description: A multipart/form-data body, keyed by part name. A string part is a templated field, and an artifact part is a file.

HttpMultipartFile.title: HttpMultipartFile
HttpMultipartFile.description: A file part, carrying a stored artifact's bytes and content type.

HttpExportDeclaration.title: HttpExportDeclaration
HttpExportDeclaration.description: A value selected from a JSON response and stored as its own artifact.
